title: Income Tax Rules on Capital Gains (STCG and LTCG)
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Capital gains arise upon the sale or transfer of a capital asset. Listed equity shares and equity-oriented mutual funds held for more than 12 months qualify as Long-Term Capital Assets. Under Section 112A, Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) on equity exceeding ₹1,25,000 in a financial year are taxed at 12.5% (without indexation). Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) on equity held for 12 months or less are taxed at 20% under Section 111A. Debt mutual fund gains are taxed at applicable slab rates.
